subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be exposed through a new `dmThreadMode` account key, folded into the existing `replyToMode` contract, or left unsupported after the prior DM invalid-thread fix?
rationale: Source review can identify the missing config contract, but only maintainers can decide the public configuration shape and whether re-enabling DM thread targets is an accepted Google Chat product behavior.

options.title: Fold Into ReplyToMode
options.body: Use the existing threading configuration surface for any accepted DM opt-in and avoid a second DM-only source of truth.

options.title: Accept dmThreadMode
options.body: Ship the separate key only after adding exported types, generated metadata, docs/help, upgrade notes, tests, and real Google Chat proof.

options.title: Keep DM Thread Suppression
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers want to preserve the current flat-DM policy established by the invalid-thread fix.

recommendation.title: Fold Into ReplyToMode
recommendation.body: Use the existing threading configuration surface for any accepted DM opt-in and avoid a second DM-only source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across Google Chat thread support, the DM suppression follow-up, and reply-delivery paths.
